naslov: Warriors host Lakers Friday for NBA Cup group stage game
tekst:
Los Angeles Lakers (4-1, fourth in the Western Conference) vs. Golden State Warriors (2-3, 10th in the Western Conference)
              San Francisco; Friday, 10 p.m. EDT
              LINE: Lakers -1.5; over/under is 236.5
              BOTTOM LINE: The Los Angeles Lakers visit the Los Angeles Lakers in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup.
              Golden State went 37-45 overall and 24-28 in Western Conference action a season ago. The Warriors averaged 114.6 points per game last season, 17.0 from the free-throw line and 47.1 from 3-point range.
              Los Angeles went 53-29 overall and 33-19 in Western Conference games during the 2025-26 season. The Lakers shot 50.2% from the field and 35.9% from 3-point range last season.
              The teams play for the second time this season. The Lakers won the last meeting 127-105 on Oct. 22, with Luka Doncic scoring 28 points in the win.
              INJURIES: Warriors: Gui Santos: day to day (knee), Moses Moody: out (knee), Kristaps Porzingis: out (illness), Jimmy Butler III: out (knee).
              Lakers: Adou Thiero: out (injury management), Cameron Carr: out (oblique), Ziaire Williams: out (foot), Luka Doncic: out (back).
